text:
Tara (CS): Flagging a small but noisy issue — several EU dedicated tenants saw a vectors freshness lag this morning after a config churn. Customers reporting search hits returning older results. Opening thread to coordinate customer comms and next steps.

Ethan (SRE): Investigating now. Early telemetry shows embed-writer throughput dropped after a config reload at 03:07 UTC. Queue length spiked and some backfills timed out.

Marta (Eng): Reproducer: the reload applied an identifier mapping tweak that inadvertently disabled the fast-path sharding, causing a 10x throughput regression for the rewriter. Canary didn't catch it because the test workload was too small.

Noah (Support): Affected ticket list: CS-331, CS-338, CS-342. Customers asking whether vectors were lost and when fixes will be completed.

Ethan (SRE): No data loss. We reverted the config at 03:22 UTC and requeued backfills. As of 03:50 UTC, most known tenants show embeddings within expected freshness. Adding alert rule: embed-freshness < 95% for >10m will page infra.

Tara (CS): Comms asks: 1) send immediate short update to affected customers; 2) prepare an expanded RCA and timeline for renewal-risk accounts; 3) propose compensation (trial extension or small credit) and offer an ops walkthrough.

Marta (Eng): Draft short status for tickets: "We observed a temporary delay in embedding updates for a subset of EU dedicated tenants between ~03:0703:22 UTC due to a configuration change that reduced rewriter throughput. The change was reverted and backfill is in progress; no customer data was lost. Please reply if you still see stale search results."

Noah (Support): Sending that short note now to the open tickets. I'll include a pointer to the office hours invite if customers want a walkthrough.

Ethan (SRE): Timeline bullets for RCA: 03:07 UTC  config reload with mapping change; 03:10 UTC  embed queue growth detected; 03:18 UTC  latency spike escalated; 03:22 UTC  revert applied; 03:50 UTC  backfill largely complete. Root cause: regression in mapping config that bypassed sharding fast-path.

Tara (CS): Compensation plan: for high-touch/renewal-risk accounts offer a 2-week trial extension + 2-hr ops session. For others offer a 72-hour extension or a one-time 5% credit. Approve? :thinking_face:

Marta (Eng): Approve. Also adding follow-ups: CI canary should include a small synthetic embed freshness check and we should add a config lint that rejects mapping changes that remove sharding flags.

Ethan (SRE): Preventive actions to include in customer RCA: gated deploys when embed-freshness < 98% in canary; config linter rule; and a new smoke test that runs a sample embed-write+read.

Noah (Support): I've posted ticket updates and added provisional compensation offers. Waiting on the final exec RCA template for renewal accounts.

OpsBot: Revert of mapping config completed at 03:22 UTC. Health checks green. :white_check_mark:

Tara (CS): Draft exec RCA blurb (for tailored emails): "Between 03:0703:22 UTC a configuration change disabled an internal sharding fast-path used by our embedding writer, which reduced throughput and caused delayed vector refresh for a small group of EU dedicated tenants. We reverted the change, prioritized backfill, verified vector freshness, and implemented monitoring and CI guardrails to prevent recurrence. No customer vectors were lost. We are offering extended trial time or a credit and a complimentary ops review to impacted customers."

Marta (Eng): Minor wording tweak: replace "disabled" with "inadvertently bypassed".

Tara (CS): Updated. Final checklist before send: 1) confirm impacted tenant list (Tara) 2) attach backfill job IDs to tickets (Ethan) 3) post ticket updates (Noah) 4) schedule office hours invite and include survey link (Tara).

Ethan (SRE): Backfill job IDs attached. All monitored tenants report freshness within SLA as of 03:50 UTC.

Noah (Support): Short status posted. I'll send the exec RCA to renewal-risk accounts once you paste the final template, Tara.

Tara (CS): Will send short status at 09:30 UTC and the tailored exec notes plus compensation offers by 13:00 UTC. Will share attendee list for office hours here after send. Thanks everyone. :pray:
